st: Harry Potter made by Pixar (or on steroids) and summer hits generated by Artificial Intelligence

sec.t: ff.63.1 Harry Potter between Pixar, steroids and summer raves
sec.p: Yes, I know, AI styling is widely known by now. But a few examples amazed me so much that I want to share them here (in case you missed them).
Matt Wolfe extends styling to video. That “continuous dreaming” of Artificial Intelligence we're now used to is, every single time, a real mind trip!

sec.t: ff.63.3 Creating a virtual copy of yourself
sec.p: Manolis Kellis, in his fifth chat with Lex Fridman, talks about digital twins of human beings, able to replicate a person's thoughts.

sec.t: ff.63.4 Ai se eu te pego?
sec.p: It's funny that the name of the famous summer earworm also contains “AI”. Drake AI (a digital twin of the singer whose voice is replicated by AI) released its first album, Better Late Than Never.
